It presents a comprehensive measure of money. According to Friedman, money is demanded for the following reasons:-  For purpose of transaction.  Because money is an asset. That's why his theory is also called the theory of wealth.  Money is also like a durable consumption good. Friedman took money in both human and non-human forms, he divided money into bonds, equity, shares, human and non-human forms.
